title: The Donkey Reads (The Master of the Muzzle)

full_text:
Tasked by a harsh governor to teach his donkey to read within five years, Nasruddin trained the animal to turn pages with its tongue by spreading barley meal between the leaves of an enormous parchment manuscript.

When the donkey turned the final page and found no grain, it threw back its head and let out a mighty bray.

"Look, Governor!" announced Nasruddin with grave dignity. "The donkey has read through the entire treaty on civil governance, and is now delivering his oral critique of your administration's tax policies!" The governor was so amused that he awarded the Mulla a robe of honor.
moral: True wisdom outlasts mortal threats by applying patience and clever insight.
